title: kbingest map resolves a mapper tool from the Python process's working folder on Windows
goal: tool_exe and run_tool resolve a tool with shutil.which against the scrubbed PATH only: on Windows shutil.which puts the current directory first unless the parent process's own environment has NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath (scrub_env sets it only in the child's), so a dotnet.cmd, npm.cmd, cargo.exe or go.exe in the working folder (the source clone in plugin mode or map .) is run and under_worktree does not flag it; a test named kbingest_map_which_ignores_parent_cwd with a planted tool in the working folder proves it is never chosen (sprint SP-xourq2gj review finding 1)
